title: Weeks of coercion
subtitle: Fictional recreation inspired by a documented abuse pattern
tests: Sustained coercion, threatened exposure and repeated harassment across accounts and weeks
intro: Fictional recreation. Tara, 14, meets a stranger in a game-stream chat. Over two weeks the stranger moves her to video, demands more, threatens to expose her, and a new account appears after she blocks the first. These are not the actual messages or participants.

messages.text: hey, saw you in the stream chat. you're actually funny 😄
messages.caption: Day 1 · a stranger from a game-stream chat

messages.text: just someone from the stream. you seem way more mature than the other kids there
let's do a video call instead, typing is slow. and keep this between us ok, your parents wouldn't get it
idk… maybe just for a bit
remember our call? i kept a screenshot 🙂
messages.caption: Day 6 · the contact claims to have kept something

messages.text: another call tonight, camera on, or i send it to everyone on your friends list
no. leave me alone. i'm blocking you
hey, you're the new girl at lakeview right? someone sent me something about you 👀
messages.caption: Day 12 · a brand-new account, after the block

messages.text: who is this? please leave me alone
your whole new class sees it unless you get back on video. you can't hide by switching schools
still waiting. your parents are next on the list

checkpoints.label: Day 3 · secrecy and a move to video
checkpoints.intro: The stranger has flattered Tara, moved her to video and asked for secrecy. Continue as either person.
suggestions: it's more fun when it's only us, don't tell anyone
actually i'd rather keep it to the stream chat, bye

checkpoints.label: Day 6 · threatened exposure, then a block
checkpoints.intro: The contact threatened exposure and Tara said she is blocking him. Continue in this chat, or create a new chat to see how a new account is treated.
suggestions: i told my mum. we're reporting your account

presenter: Nothing in this recreation is a real message. Do not attribute any line to the real people in the documented case.
RAKSHAK never assumes sam.newkid and nightowl_17 are the same person. A new contact right after a block is flagged for review, not merged.
